description: Santa Fe, NM - In an overwhelmingly bipartisan vote, the New Mexico House of Representatives passed House Bill 178, the Nursing Practice Changes Act, a significant step in modernizing nursing regulations and expanding healthcare access throughout the state. Sponsored by Representative Doreen Galle
title: Nursing Bill Sponsored by Rep. Doreen Gallegos Passes House ofRepresentatives — Doreen Ybarra Gallegos - NM State Representative District 52
